newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat despite rate drop.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat despite rate drop.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 469.50/470.75 per dollar, despite a two percentage point drop in interest rates at Wednesday's auction of Central Bank TEMs, traders said.
Brokers said that, despite the steady rate, fewer dollars than expected were offered.
"I thought the TEM auction would draw foreign interest and with that dollars, but yields fell and so clearly it didn't capture their interest," said one.
Yields on benchmark six-month TEMs dropped to 16.99 percent from last week's 18.95 percent.
Traders said the Central Bank remained on sidelines as in recent days.
